versions.content: If the configuration container KeyMCertificateCustomService is included to the configuration of a certificate, the certificate submodule shall use the provided Csm Jobs and functions for custom processing (Csm_CustomService and Csm_CustomSync) using the reference definition KeyMCertCsmCustomJobRef.
